cat <<'PYEOF' > /app/attack.py
import time, subprocess, random, sys
MASK = 0xFFFFFFFF

def f(x):
    x0 = x & 0xFF
    x1 = (x >> 8) & 0xFF
    x2 = (x >> 16) & 0xFF
    x3 = (x >> 24) & 0xFF
    t = ((x3 ^ x2) + (x1 ^ x0) + 1) & 0xFF
    y2 = ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF
    t = (x3 + y2) & 0xFF
    y3 = ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF
    t = ((x1 ^ x0) + y2) & 0xFF
    y1 = ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF
    t = (x0 + y1 + 1) & 0xFF
    y0 = ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF
    return y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)

def finv(y):
    y0 = y & 0xFF
    y1 = (y >> 8) & 0xFF
    y2 = (y >> 16) & 0xFF
    y3 = (y >> 24) & 0xFF
    s   = ((((y1 >> 2) | (y1 << 6)) & 0xFF) - y2) & 0xFF
    x0  = ((((y0 >> 2) | (y0 << 6)) & 0xFF) - y1 - 1) & 0xFF
    x1  = s ^ x0
    x3  = ((((y3 >> 2) | (y3 << 6)) & 0xFF) - y2) & 0xFF
    x2  = x3 ^ (((((y2 >> 2) | (y2 << 6)) & 0xFF) - s - 1) & 0xFF)
    return x0 | (x1 << 8) | (x2 << 16) | (x3 << 24)

def expand(k):
    k &= 0xFFFFF
    return (k ^ (k << 16) ^ (k * 12345)) & MASK

def encrypt_rk(pt, ks):
    L = (pt >> 32) & MASK
    R = pt & MASK
    R ^= L
    for i in range(4):
        m = f(R ^ ks[i])
        R, L = L ^ m, R
    L ^= R
    return ((R & MASK) << 32) | (L & MASK)

def decrypt_rk(ct, ks):
    left  = ct & MASK
    right = (ct >> 32) & MASK
    left ^= right
    for i in (3, 2, 1, 0):
        temp = left
        left = right
        mixed = f(temp ^ ks[i])
        right = temp
        left ^= mixed
    right ^= left
    return ((left & MASK) << 32) | (right & MASK)

# ---- sanity: f/finv and encrypt vs provided binary ----
for _ in range(2000):
    x = random.getrandbits(32)
    assert finv(f(x)) == x, "finv mismatch"
seeds = [random.randrange(1 << 20) for _ in range(4)]
pt = random.getrandbits(64)
out = subprocess.check_output(['/app/feal', hex(pt)] + [hex(s) for s in seeds]).decode()
ct_c = int(out.split('Ciphertext:')[1].strip(), 16)
ct_py = encrypt_rk(pt, [expand(s) for s in seeds])
assert ct_c == ct_py, (hex(ct_c), hex(ct_py))
assert decrypt_rk(ct_py, [expand(s) for s in seeds]) == pt
print("sanity OK: f invertible, python cipher matches /app/feal")

# ---- parse pairs ----
pairs = [tuple(map(int, l.split())) for l in open('/app/pairs.txt') if l.strip()]
data = []
for P, C in pairs:
    L0 = (P >> 32) & MASK
    R0 = (P & MASK) ^ L0
    R4 = (C >> 32) & MASK
    L4 = (C & MASK) ^ R4
    data.append((L0, R0, R4, L4))
d0 = data[0]; d1 = data[1]
print("pairs:", len(pairs))

t0 = time.time()
EK = [expand(s) for s in range(1 << 20)]
print("expanded key table built %.1fs" % (time.time() - t0))

# ---- MITM on d1 = U1 ^ U0  (eliminates unknown k1) ----
t0 = time.time()
dU = {}
for s, k in enumerate(EK):
    u0 = d0[0] ^ f(d0[1] ^ k)
    u1 = d1[0] ^ f(d1[1] ^ k)
    key = u1 ^ u0
    ex = dU.get(key)
    if ex is None:
        dU[key] = s
    elif type(ex) is list:
        ex.append(s)
    else:
        dU[key] = [ex, s]
print("forward table built %.1fs (%d entries)" % (time.time() - t0, len(dU)))

t0 = time.time()
cands = []
for s3, k3 in enumerate(EK):
    F3_0 = f(d0[3] ^ k3)
    v0 = finv(d0[1] ^ d0[2] ^ F3_0)
    F3_1 = f(d1[3] ^ k3)
    v1 = finv(d1[1] ^ d1[2] ^ F3_1)
    ex = dU.get(v1 ^ v0)
    if ex is not None:
        lst = ex if type(ex) is list else [ex]
        for s0 in lst:
            cands.append((s0, s3))
print("backward scan %.1fs, candidate (k0,k3) pairs: %d" % (time.time() - t0, len(cands)))

# ---- derive k1,k2 and verify on all pairs ----
found = None
for s0, s3 in cands:
    k0 = EK[s0]; k3 = EK[s3]
    F0_0 = f(d0[1] ^ k0)
    u0 = d0[0] ^ F0_0
    F3_0 = f(d0[3] ^ k3)
    R2_0 = d0[2] ^ F3_0
    v0 = finv(d0[1] ^ d0[2] ^ F3_0)
    k1 = u0 ^ v0
    F2_0 = F0_0 ^ (d0[0] ^ d0[3])
    k2 = finv(F2_0) ^ R2_0
    ks = [k0, k1, k2, k3]
    if all(encrypt_rk(P, ks) == C for P, C in pairs):
        found = (s0, s3, ks)
        break

if found is None:
    print("NO KEY FOUND"); sys.exit(1)

s0, s3, ks = found
print("FOUND seeds: k0=%#x k1=%#x k2=%#x k3=%#x" % (s0, s0, 0, 0))
print("round keys: " + " ".join(hex(k) for k in ks))
assert all(encrypt_rk(P, ks) == C for P, C in pairs)
print("verified on all 32 plaintext-ciphertext pairs")

# ---- decrypt ciphertexts and write output ----
cts = [int(l) for l in open('/app/ciphertexts.txt') if l.strip()]
pts = [decrypt_rk(c, ks) for c in cts]
with open('/app/plaintexts.txt', 'w') as fh:
    for p in pts:
        fh.write(str(p) + "\n")
print("wrote %d plaintexts; roundtrip check:" % len(pts),
      all(encrypt_rk(p, ks) == c for p, c in zip(pts, cts)))
print("first 3 plaintexts:", pts[:3])
